notes.title: Patch Notes: Minor Update
notes.content:
This update is a small one, but it brings a few subtle improvements to the story and overall feel of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032089/200ee339d7510f27358af3dec3a6267c0d78a9cc.png[/img]
[h3]🛠 Improved Story Experience[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some cutscenes have been adjusted to make the flow of the story feel more natural.
[*] A few new cutscenes have also been added to help deepen the characters and their backgrounds.
[/list]
[h3]🔊 Sound Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] We've added several sound effects to cutscenes (using Soundly), bringing more life and atmosphere to character movements and scene changes.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 Other Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] A handful of minor bugs have been fixed. If something felt a little off before, you might notice things running a bit smoother now.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: A livelier look for dialogue, and more freedom in graphics settings
notes.content:
Here’s what’s new in this update:

[h3]Subtle animation added to dialogue bubbles[/h3]
Character dialogue now features gentle movement. It’s a small touch, but it helps make conversations feel a little more lively and natural.

[h3]Cloud sync for graphics settings disabled[/h3]
Since sharing the same graphics settings across PCs with different performance levels doesn’t make much sense, we’ve disabled cloud sync for these settings. This allows each PC to use graphics settings that best suit its own environment.

[h3]🛠 For advanced users:[/h3]
If you’d like more fine-grained control, you can manually edit the following file to customize resolution, effects, and other settings:
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Umi\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini

notes.title: Update: Italian and Brazilian Portuguese Now Supported!
notes.content:
Ciao! Olá!
Hello to everyone visiting the village of Brass.
We hope you're enjoying your time at a gentle, relaxing pace.

With this update, we've added support for [b]Italian[/b] and [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]!
Now even more players can experience the story of this little village in their own language.

No matter the words, warm feelings always find their way through.

Thank you for continuing to support Brass.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Graphics Quality Settings
notes.content:
We’ve added a new “Graphics Quality” option to the settings menu, allowing you to choose between Low, Medium, and High settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032089/eee094e6fd6ac4861459f23116deac3b2a55799a.png[/img]

If you find the game is running slowly, try setting this option to Medium or Low.

Previously, the game defaulted to High quality. Starting with this version, Medium is now the default setting.

We’ve also made various small fixes and adjustments.
